# skills

The skills this layer owns: the paper content adapter's skills (`content/folio-paper-adapter/`, with `authoring-math`, `hypothesis-generation`, `scientific-critical-thinking` and `scientific-visualization` beside it), plus `lean/`, `data/` and the `voices/` subgraph, which `skills/skills.json` declares from within. Declared here explicitly on 2026-10-04 (bean `g2sv`, issue #2106). The directory was already reachable through the `skills` entry of `DEFAULT_DIRECTORIES`, which `ownDirectories` seeds for every instance and marks `declaredBy: (default)`, so `skill_list` already served its packages. A read-only analysis of the qou folio nonetheless reported it as undeclared and reachable only through `known-skills.ts`, because the declaration file was the only place the analysis looked, and that file said nothing. A convention is not visible from the declaration a reader opens, and a reader should not have to know the fallback to learn that this instance's largest graph exists. The id is `skills`, the CONVENTIONAL one, so this entry OVERRIDES the default rather than joining it. The reason is the one the `library` entry above gives: overrides match on id and never on path, so a distinct id at the same path would make two entries for one directory.

Part of [folio-assistant-sci](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `skills`, holding `skills`.
